5.headline: Suggestive at 1 week: 10+ completed outcomes; excess medians lean the same way at 5, 10 and 20 sessions, but not all Reliable criteria are met.
5.why: 18 completed outcomes in 18 overlap blocks; the 90% interval on the excess median runs −1.8% to +3.0%; 34.3% of resampled medians are adverse against a 3% bar.
